heroes.name: Nowa
heroes.recruit_id: Otomatis — protagonis utama, anggota baru Eltisweiss Watch di Arenside.
heroes.recruit_en: Automatic — the main protagonist, a new member of the Eltisweiss Watch in Arenside.
heroes.desc_id: Nowa adalah protagonis utama — pemuda jujur dari Desa Kyshiri yang masuk Watch buat ngikutin jejak ayahnya. Pemberani, gampang dipercaya, dan selalu maju paling depan. Dia karakter utamamu sejak awal cerita, otomatis gabung.
heroes.desc_en: Nowa is the main protagonist — an honest young man from Kyshiri Village who joined the Watch to follow in his father's footsteps. Brave, trustworthy, and always at the front. He's your main character from the start, joining automatically.

gameplay.recruitment: Nowa | Arenside | As the protagonist, Nowa is available from the beginning of the game.; First Mission

heroes.recruit_id: Eltisweiss — di dalam rumah kecil di bagian timur kota.
heroes.recruit_en: Eltisweiss — inside a small house in the eastern part of the city.
heroes.desc_id: Iugo adalah prajurit Watch yang setia dan bisa diandalkan di misi apa pun. Tipe yang kerja beres tanpa banyak drama. Dia bisa direkrut di Eltisweiss setelah Nowa diangkat jadi Kapten Watch.
heroes.desc_en: Iugo is a loyal Watch soldier you can rely on in any mission. The type who gets the job done without drama. He can be recruited in Eltisweiss after Nowa becomes Watch Captain.

heroes.recruit_en: Eltisweiss — meet her as you exit Eltisweiss plaza, then help her defeat the Nerthus boss at Redthroat Ridge.
heroes.desc_id: Mellore adalah gadis penyihir magang yang rajin tapi agak kaku. Sihirnya menjanjikan walau pengalamannya masih hijau. Rekrut dia di Eltisweiss setelah kamu jadi Kapten Watch.
heroes.desc_en: Mellore is a diligent but slightly stiff apprentice mage. Her magic shows promise though her experience is still green. Recruit her in Eltisweiss after you become Watch Captain.

gameplay.recruitment: Mellore | Eltisweiss | Encounter her on Eltisweiss's central vertical street and aid her in defeating the Nerthus at Redthroat Ridge .; The Watch Captain's First Job

heroes.desc_id: Yume adalah gadis kecil ceria yang selalu penasaran sama dunia luar. Jangan remehkan semangatnya yang membara. Dia bisa direkrut di Eltisweiss.
heroes.desc_en: Yume is a cheerful little girl who's always curious about the outside world. Don't underestimate her burning enthusiasm. She can be recruited in Eltisweiss.

heroes.recruit_en: Altverden Village — in front of one of the houses.
heroes.desc_id: Kuroto adalah pendekar dari negeri timur dengan gaya samurai yang anggun sekaligus mematikan. Tenang, terhormat, dan presisi. Temui dia di Eltisweiss buat ngajak gabung.
heroes.desc_en: Kuroto is a swordsman from the eastern lands with an elegant yet deadly samurai style. Calm, honorable, and precise. Find him in Eltisweiss to invite him along.

gameplay.recruitment: Kuroto | Altverden Village | Speak to him in the southwest area of the village and defeat three Wild Boar s in Redthroat Ridge . Kills prior to speaking with him are counted.; The Watch Captain's First Job

heroes.desc_en: Francesca is a kind-hearted healer always ready to mend anyone. Her smile soothes, her healing magic delivers. She joins early in the story as the party healer.

heroes.desc_id: Yusuke adalah bocah pemberani yang pengin jadi kesatria hebat. Kecil-kecil tapi nyalinya nggak kecil. Rekrut dia di Eltisweiss.
heroes.desc_en: Yusuke is a brave kid who dreams of becoming a great knight. Small in size, big in courage. Recruit him in Eltisweiss.

heroes.desc_id: Gigina adalah petarung bertubuh raksasa dengan hati yang sama besarnya. Sekali pukul, musuh mikir dua kali. Cari dia di Eltisweiss buat direkrut.
heroes.desc_en: Gigina is a giant-bodied fighter with a heart just as big. One punch makes enemies think twice. Find him in Eltisweiss to recruit him.

heroes.desc_id: Sabine adalah wanita bangsawan Eltisweiss yang anggun tapi tegas. Di balik sopan santunnya ada tekad baja. Ajak dia gabung saat menjelajahi Eltisweiss.
heroes.desc_en: Sabine is an elegant yet firm noblewoman of Eltisweiss. Behind her courtesy lies a will of steel. Invite her along while exploring Eltisweiss.

gameplay.recruitment: Sabine | Eltisweiss | Joins automatically before setting off to investigate Werne Village .; Infiltrate the Empire

heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — bergabung saat para penyintas berkumpul setelah Eltisweiss diserang.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — joins when survivors regroup after Eltisweiss is ransacked.
heroes.desc_id: Ymir adalah kurcaci pengrajin yang ahli soal senjata dan peralatan. Omongannya ceplas-ceplos tapi tangannya terampil. Temui dia di Eltisweiss.
heroes.desc_en: Ymir is a dwarf craftsman who knows weapons and gear inside out. Blunt in speech, skilled with his hands. Meet him in Eltisweiss.

gameplay.recruitment: Ymir | Castle Ruins | Joins automatically upon establishing the Alliance army.; Hoist the Alliance Banner

heroes.name: Sumire
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — salah satu penyintas yang bergabung.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — one of the survivors who joins.
heroes.desc_id: Sumire adalah pendekar wanita dari timur dengan teknik pedang yang indah sekaligus mematikan. Dingin di luar, setia di dalam. Rekrut dia di Eltisweiss.
heroes.desc_en: Sumire is a swordswoman from the east with a blade technique as beautiful as it is deadly. Cold outside, loyal within. Recruit her in Eltisweiss.

gameplay.recruitment: Sumire | Castle Ruins | Joins automatically upon establishing the Alliance army.; Hoist the Alliance Banner

heroes.name: Cassandra
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — bergabung dengan pasukan baru.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — joins the fledgling force.
heroes.desc_id: Cassandra adalah wanita misterius dengan masa lalu yang jarang diceritakan. Auranya bikin penasaran siapa pun yang melihat. Cari dia di Eltisweiss setelah progres cerita tertentu.
heroes.desc_en: Cassandra is a mysterious woman with a past she rarely speaks of. Her aura intrigues everyone who meets her. Find her in Eltisweiss after certain story progress.

gameplay.recruitment: Cassandra | Castle Ruins | Joins automatically upon establishing the Alliance army.; Hoist the Alliance Banner

heroes.name: Kogen
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — setelah bertarung melawannya di Abandoned Mines, dia dan gengnya bergabung saat evakuasi Eltisweiss.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — after fighting him in the Abandoned Mines, he and his gang join during the Eltisweiss evacuation.
heroes.desc_id: Kogen adalah ninja lincah yang bergerak tanpa suara. Ahli menyelinap dan menyerang dari bayangan. Ajak dia gabung saat menjelajah Eltisweiss.
heroes.desc_en: Kogen is an agile ninja who moves without a sound. A master of stealth and strikes from shadow. Invite him along while exploring Eltisweiss.

gameplay.recruitment: Kogen | Castle Ruins | Joins automatically upon establishing the Alliance army.; Hoist the Alliance Banner

heroes.name: Gocteau
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — penyintas yang bergabung di tahap ini.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — another survivor who joins at this stage.
heroes.desc_id: Gocteau adalah ketua serikat yang karismatik dan jadi tangan kanan Nowa di markas. Urusan misi dan organisasi, serahkan ke dia. Dia gabung otomatis saat Aliansi mulai membangun Castle HQ.
heroes.desc_en: Gocteau is a charismatic guild leader who becomes Nowa's right hand at HQ. Missions and organization — leave them to him. He joins automatically when the Alliance starts building Castle HQ.

gameplay.recruitment: Gocteau | Headquarters | Joins automatically upon obtaining the headquarters.; Hoist the Alliance Banner

heroes.name: Iris
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — bergabung dengan pasukan kecil.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — joins the small army.
heroes.desc_id: Iris adalah arsitek jenius yang merancang pembangunan Castle HQ. Cerewet soal detail, tapi hasilnya selalu memukau. Dia gabung otomatis saat fase pembangunan markas dimulai.
heroes.desc_en: Iris is the genius architect designing Castle HQ's construction. Fussy about details, but her results always stun. She joins automatically when the HQ building phase begins.

gameplay.recruitment: Iris | Headquarters | Joins automatically upon obtaining the headquarters.; Hoist the Alliance Banner

heroes.name: Caine
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — direkrut bersama rombongan.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — recruited as part of the bunch.
heroes.desc_id: Caine adalah bendahara markas yang teliti ngurus dana dan gudang. Orangnya kaku soal angka, tapi justru itu yang bikin markas jalan. Dia gabung otomatis bareng tim pembangunan HQ.
heroes.desc_en: Caine is the HQ treasurer who meticulously manages funds and the warehouse. Strict about numbers, and that's exactly what keeps HQ running. He joins automatically with the HQ building team.

gameplay.recruitment: Caine | Headquarters | Joins automatically upon obtaining the headquarters.; Hoist the Alliance Banner

heroes.name: Martha
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — di timur reruntuhan plaza, bibi Nowa.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — east of the plaza ruins, Nowa's auntie.
heroes.desc_id: Martha adalah peternak ramah yang ngurus Pasturage di markas. Sayang sama hewan-hewannya kayak keluarga sendiri. Rekrut dia lalu bangun Pasturage di Drafting Studio.
heroes.desc_en: Martha is a friendly rancher who runs the Pasturage at HQ. She loves her animals like family. Recruit her, then build the Pasturage at the Drafting Studio.

gameplay.recruitment: Martha | Headquarters | Speak to Martha on the east side of the headquarters.; Hoist the Alliance Banner

heroes.name: Ormond
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine — lewat pintu belakang lantai 1 HQ (kuburan), turun ke sumur, lalu ke barat daya sampai pintu keluar tak bertanda.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine — through the back door on HQ's first floor (graveyard), down the well, then southwest to an unmarked exit.
heroes.desc_id: Ormond adalah mandor tambang kekar yang ngurus Quarry. Suaranya menggelegar, kerjanya beres. Rekrut dia buat membuka Quarry di markas.
heroes.desc_en: Ormond is a burly mine foreman who runs the Quarry. Booming voice, solid work. Recruit him to open the Quarry at HQ.

gameplay.recruitment: Ormond | Abandoned Mine | Bring 3 Iron Ore to Ormond. He is located immediately to the south of the new shortcut by the ladder to the headquarters.; Hoist the Alliance Banner

heroes.name: Hiro
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine — di bagian pilar berputar; bisa direkrut setelah Town HQ Level 2.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine — in the looping pillars section; recruitable after Town HQ Level 2.
heroes.desc_id: Hiro adalah pedagang serba-bisa yang buka Tool Shop di markas. Ramah dan selalu punya barang yang kamu butuhkan. Rekrut dia lalu bangun Tool Shop.
heroes.desc_en: Hiro is a versatile merchant who opens the Tool Shop at HQ. Friendly, and always stocks what you need. Recruit him, then build the Tool Shop.

gameplay.recruitment: Hiro | Abandoned Mine | Speak to Hiro in his usual spot.; Hoist the Alliance Banner

heroes.name: Galdorf
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine — di ruang pertama (dari pintu world map); bawakan Paleknight Mail (loot di bekas lokasi Ormond atau Proving Grounds).
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine — in the first chamber (from the world map entrance); bring a Paleknight Mail (looted where Ormond was, or in Proving Grounds).
heroes.desc_id: Galdorf adalah veteran perang bertubuh besar dengan pengalaman segudang. Cerita medan perangnya nggak ada habisnya. Temui dia di salah satu kota buat ngajak gabung.
heroes.desc_en: Galdorf is a large-bodied war veteran with a wealth of experience. His battlefield stories never end. Meet him in one of the towns to invite him along.

gameplay.recruitment: Galdorf | Abandoned Mine | Speak to Galdorf at the entrance to the mine and bring him the Palenight Mail , which can be found next to Ormond's spot in the mine. The armor cannot be equipped at the time of recruiting.; Hoist the Alliance Banner

heroes.desc_en: Falward is a calm knight who upholds his code of honor. Loyal and dependable on the front line. Find him in the towns you visit.

heroes.desc_id: Kerrin adalah penebang kayu kekar yang ngurus Woodcutter's Cabin. Kapaknya nggak cuma buat pohon. Rekrut dia buat membuka Woodcutter's Cabin di markas.
heroes.desc_en: Kerrin is a burly lumberjack who runs the Woodcutter's Cabin. His axe isn't just for trees. Recruit him to open the Woodcutter's Cabin at HQ.

heroes.desc_en: Gieran is a calm hunter skilled at reading tracks and terrain. Quiet, but sharply observant. Find him around forested areas.

gameplay.recruitment: Gieran | The Greatwood – East | Speak to Gieran in the forest. Defeat the Ancient Seed sub-boss and bring him the Rune of Conservation it drops.; The Village of the Treefolk

heroes.recruit_id: Treefolk Village — memimpin tim ke Greatwood; bergabung permanen setelah dungeon Proving Grounds selesai.

heroes.desc_id: Kallathor adalah prajurit gagah dengan gaya bertarung agresif. Pantang mundur sekali maju. Temui dia buat ngajak gabung ke Aliansi.
heroes.desc_en: Kallathor is a gallant warrior with an aggressive fighting style. He never backs down once committed. Meet him to invite him to the Alliance.

heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — appears on the town's main path after the Treefolk Village/Proving Grounds events.
heroes.desc_id: Chron adalah pencatat rajin yang ngurus Achievement Society di markas. Semua pencapaianmu dicatat rapi sama dia. Rekrut dia lalu bangun Achievement Society.
heroes.desc_en: Chron is a diligent record-keeper who runs the Achievement Society at HQ. He logs all your accomplishments neatly. Recruit him, then build the Achievement Society.

gameplay.recruitment: Chron | Headquarters | Speak to Chron at the entrance to the Headquarters .; Euchrisse, the Land of Water

heroes.name: Squash
heroes.recruit_id: Treefolk Village — di depan trading post; kembali ke Dappled Forest, lawan Phantombird sampai dapat Sparklestone.
heroes.recruit_en: Treefolk Village — in front of the trading post; return to Dappled Forest and fight Phantombirds until a Sparklestone drops.
heroes.desc_id: Squash adalah pedagang aksesori yang cerewet tapi jeli soal barang bagus. Koleksinya lengkap. Rekrut dia buat membuka Accessory Shop.
heroes.desc_en: Squash is a chatty accessory merchant with a sharp eye for quality goods. His collection is complete. Recruit him to open the Accessory Shop.

gameplay.recruitment: Squash | Treefolk Village | Speak to Squash beside the town's Trading Post. Bring him a Sparklestone . The item is dropped by Phantombird s and Red Wyvern s in the Dappled Forest .; Euchrisse, the Land of Water

heroes.name: Pastole
heroes.recruit_id: Twinhorne East — temui setelah Proving Grounds, lewat jalur Greatwood (South).
heroes.recruit_en: Twinhorne East — meet after the Proving Grounds via the Greatwood (South) path.
heroes.desc_id: Pastole adalah pemburu ulung yang ngurus Hunter's Cabin. Hasil buruannya selalu berkualitas. Rekrut dia buat membuka Hunter's Cabin di markas.
heroes.desc_en: Pastole is a master hunter who runs the Hunter's Cabin. His hunts always yield quality goods. Recruit him to open the Hunter's Cabin at HQ.

gameplay.recruitment: Pastole | Twinhorne East | Speak to Pastole next to the town's tool shop.; Euchrisse, the Land of Water

heroes.name: Mariette
heroes.recruit_id: Twinhorne East — dia kehilangan charm saat lari dari Rabbit Archwitch; kembali ke Greatwood (South), lawan Rabbit Archwitch dan loot peti dengan Attack/Gimmick.
heroes.recruit_en: Twinhorne East — she lost her charm fleeing a Rabbit Archwitch; return to Greatwood (South), fight Rabbit Archwitches and loot chests with Attack/Gimmick.
heroes.desc_id: Mariette adalah kutu buku yang cinta mati sama koleksi bukunya. Ngurus Library di markas dengan penuh dedikasi. Rekrut dia lalu bangun Library.
heroes.desc_en: Mariette is a bookworm devoted to her collection. She runs the HQ Library with full dedication. Recruit her, then build the Library.

gameplay.recruitment: Mariette | Twinhorne East | Speak to Mariette and retreive her Mariette's Charm . It is obtained through a Treasure Chest gimmick in battle against a Rabbit Archwitch in the The Greatwood – South .; Euchrisse, the Land of Water

heroes.name: Perrielle
heroes.recruit_id: Hishahn — bangsawan House Grum; resmi bergabung setelah negosiasi dengan pejabat Hishahn.
heroes.recruit_en: Hishahn — noble scion of House Grum; officially joins after negotiations with Hishahn officials.
heroes.desc_id: Perrielle adalah Lady penguasa Euchrisse, Negeri Air. Anggun, bijaksana, dan disegani rakyatnya. Dia bergabung dengan Aliansi seiring berjalannya cerita di Greatwood.
heroes.desc_en: Perrielle is the Lady ruling Euchrisse, the Land of Water. Graceful, wise, and revered by her people. She joins the Alliance as the Greatwood story unfolds.

gameplay.recruitment: Perrielle Grum | Hishahn | Joins automatically at the inn in Hishahn.; Euchrisse, the Land of Water

heroes.desc_id: Janquis adalah ilmuwan eksentrik yang terobsesi sama penelitian rune-lens. Ngomongnya cepat dan penuh teori aneh. Temui dia buat ngajak gabung.
heroes.desc_en: Janquis is an eccentric scholar obsessed with rune-lens research. He talks fast, full of strange theories. Meet him to invite him along.

gameplay.recruitment: Janquis | Hishahn | Joins automatically at the inn in Hishahn.; Euchrisse, the Land of Water

heroes.name: Kurtz
heroes.recruit_id: Hishahn — di tengah kota, dia mencari resep; punya arc opsional dan mini-game cooking contest.
heroes.recruit_en: Hishahn — at the city center, looking for a recipe; has his own optional arc and cooking minigame.
heroes.desc_id: Kurtz adalah koki flamboyan yang perfeksionis soal rasa. Standarnya tinggi, masakannya luar biasa. Rekrut dia buat membuka Restaurant di markas.
heroes.desc_en: Kurtz is a flamboyant chef who's a perfectionist about flavor. High standards, extraordinary dishes. Recruit him to open the Restaurant at HQ.

gameplay.recruitment: Kurtz | Hishahn | Speak to Kurtz outside the Smithy, then travel to the Treefolk Village and speak to the adult Treefolk by the Trading Post to receive the Grilled Tutuva Recipe . The recipe cannot be obtained until Kurtz is spoken to; Euchrisse, the Land of Water

heroes.name: Huang
heroes.recruit_id: Hishahn — bergabung setelah berhasil menangkap ikan Wheel-eyed Bream yang sulit.
heroes.recruit_en: Hishahn — joins once you catch the elusive Wheel-eyed Bream fish.
heroes.desc_id: Huang adalah nelayan tua yang santai dan bijak soal memancing. Kasih dia Wheel Eye Bream di Hishahn biar dia mau gabung dan buka Fishing Spot.
heroes.desc_en: Huang is a laid-back old fisherman, wise in the ways of angling. Give him a Wheel Eye Bream in Hishahn and he'll join, opening the Fishing Spot.

gameplay.recruitment: Huang | Hishahn | After receiving the Bamboo Rod from Huang in Hishahn , speak to him near the Appraiser's Shop to the east. Speak to him again after catching a Wheel-Eye Bream . The fish can be caught at the Euchrisse fishing spot at any time, including before speaking to Huang in the city.; Euchrisse, the Land of Water

heroes.name: Nell
heroes.recruit_id: Hishahn — di belakang kios bagian barat laut kota.
heroes.recruit_en: Hishahn — behind the stall in the northwestern part of the city.
heroes.desc_id: Nell adalah pedagang ransel yang rapi dan terorganisir. Urusan penyimpanan dan perbekalan, dia ahlinya. Rekrut dia buat membuka Stowpack Shop.
heroes.desc_en: Nell is a neat, organized pack merchant. Storage and supplies are her expertise. Recruit her to open the Stowpack Shop.

gameplay.recruitment: Nell | Hishahn | Speak to Nell, who is hidden behind some stalls at the north-west exit to the city.; Euchrisse, the Land of Water

heroes.name: Riufan
heroes.recruit_id: Hishahn — di depan kincir air; tantang dan kalahkan dia (butuh Nowa sekitar level 33).
heroes.recruit_en: Hishahn — in front of a waterwheel; challenge and defeat him (needs Nowa around level 33).
heroes.desc_id: Riufan adalah petarung misterius dengan masa lalu kelam. Gerakannya cepat dan efisien tanpa basa-basi. Cari dia di kota-kota buat ngajak gabung.
heroes.desc_en: Riufan is a mysterious fighter with a dark past. Fast, efficient movements, no nonsense. Find him in the towns to invite him along.

gameplay.recruitment: Riufan | Hishahn | Speak to Riufan in the north side when Nowa is level 32 or higher. Defeat Riufan in a one-on-one battle.; Euchrisse, the Land of Water

heroes.desc_en: Carrie is a cheerful mage who grants fast travel — a must-recruit! With her, hopping between towns becomes effortless. Meet her on your adventure and invite her along.

heroes.recruit_en: Arenside — with her Eggfoot companion; collect 5 Plain Eggs (dropped by Eggfoots on the world map outside HQ).
heroes.desc_id: Paquia adalah perawat eggfoot yang penyayang dan telaten. Makhluk-makhluk bulat itu nurut banget sama dia. Rekrut dia (bareng Mandie) buat membuka Racing Stables.
heroes.desc_en: Paquia is a caring, patient eggfoot caretaker. Those round creatures obey her completely. Recruit her (along with Mandie) to open the Racing Stables.

gameplay.recruitment: Paquia | Arenside | Speak to Paquia by the eastern bridge and bring her 5 Regular Eggs .; New Forces

heroes.name: Mandie
heroes.recruit_id: Arenside — bergabung sekitar waktu yang sama dengan Paquia.
heroes.recruit_en: Arenside — joins around the same time as Paquia.
heroes.desc_id: Mandie adalah partner Paquia yang energik dalam mengurus eggfoot. Kompak banget kerja berdua. Rekrut dia buat membuka Racing Stables di markas.
heroes.desc_en: Mandie is Paquia's energetic partner in caring for eggfoot. They work perfectly as a pair. Recruit her to open the Racing Stables at HQ.

gameplay.recruitment: Mandie | Arenside | Speak to Paquia by the eastern bridge and bring her 5 Regular Eggs .; New Forces

heroes.name: Glen
heroes.recruit_id: Arenside — di rumah bagian barat; kalahkan dia dalam card match.
heroes.recruit_en: Arenside — at the house in the western part; beat him in a card match.
heroes.desc_id: Glen adalah pemain kartu ulung yang tenang dan licik dalam strategi. Nggak pernah main tanpa rencana matang. Rekrut dia buat membuka Card Shop dan adu kartu.
heroes.desc_en: Glen is a master card player — calm and cunning in strategy. He never plays without a solid plan. Recruit him to open the Card Shop and duel.

gameplay.recruitment: Glen | Arenside | Speak to Glen in west Arenside and defeat him at a Card Battle.; Euchrisse, the Land of Water

heroes.name: Pieter
heroes.recruit_id: Werne Village — di bagian barat laut kota.
heroes.recruit_en: Werne Village — in the northwestern part of town.
heroes.desc_id: Pieter adalah petani ulet yang ngurus Farm di markas. Tangannya dingin buat urusan tanaman. Rekrut dia lalu bangun Farm.
heroes.desc_en: Pieter is a hardworking farmer who runs the Farm at HQ. He has a green thumb for crops. Recruit him, then build the Farm.

gameplay.recruitment: Pieter | Werne Village | Speak to Pieter in the northwest farming plot of Werne Village .; Euchrisse, the Land of Water

heroes.name: Isha
heroes.recruit_id: Eltisweiss — karakter dari Eiyuden Chronicle: Rising, di dekat air mancur plaza; selesaikan 3 tugasnya: cari kucing hilang (barat daya kota), dapatkan Cockatrice Egg (Mountain Path Homeward, loot peti dengan Attack/Gimmick), antar paket ke Arenside.
heroes.recruit_en: Eltisweiss — a character from Eiyuden Chronicle: Rising, by the plaza fountain; complete her 3 tasks: find the lost cat (southwest city), obtain a Cockatrice Egg (Mountain Path Homeward, loot chest with Attack/Gimmick), deliver a package to Arenside.
heroes.desc_id: Isha adalah penjabat walikota New Nevaeh dan penyihir berbakat — salah satu protagonis Rising. Cerdas, bertanggung jawab, dan peduli sama kotanya. Dia bergabung dengan Aliansi di tengah cerita.
heroes.desc_en: Isha is the acting mayor of New Nevaeh and a gifted mage — one of Rising's protagonists. Smart, responsible, and devoted to her town. She joins the Alliance mid-story.

gameplay.recruitment: Isha | Eltisweiss | Speak with Isha at the southeastern fountain in the city and complete her three tasks. The black cat can be found in the southwest corner of the city. After this, Isha will gift the Stamp Card and additional requests. The Cockatrice Egg is obtained through a Treasure Chest gimmick in battle against a Cockatrice (adult) on the Mountain Path Homeward . The Package for Arenside is delivered to the General Store in Arenside . Speak to Isha again and she will join the party.; New Forces

heroes.desc_en: Douglas is a strong-armed blacksmith who runs the Smithy. His forging makes weapons sharper. Recruit him to open the Smithy at HQ.

heroes.desc_en: Larla is a mysterious girl with little-known unique abilities. Her aura intrigues. Meet her on your travels to invite her along.

gameplay.recruitment: Larla | Eltisweiss | Speak with Larla at the inn once the Headquarters is at Level 2 or higher, the Mission Guild is established, and at least one "Epic Success" mission rating has been achieved.; New Forces

heroes.name: Maureus

heroes.recruit_en: Mountain Path Homeward — northwestern pathway; he's looking for a powerful squad member (needs high strength/magic, ~200).
heroes.desc_id: Maureus adalah cendekiawan tua yang bijak dan penuh pengetahuan sejarah. Ceritanya soal masa lalu Allraan menarik banget. Ajak dia gabung saat bertemu.

heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — direkrut setelah memenangkan army battle di Hishahn.

heroes.recruit_id: Twinhorne East — cukup ajak bicara untuk bergabung.

heroes.desc_id: Dalton adalah petarung veteran yang sudah makan asam garam pertempuran. Pengalamannya berharga banget buat tim. Ajak dia gabung saat bertemu.
heroes.desc_en: Dalton is a veteran fighter seasoned by countless battles. His experience is priceless for the team. Invite him when you meet.

heroes.desc_id: Durlan adalah raksasa lembut yang kekuatannya luar biasa. Hatinya selembut tenaganya yang kasar. Temui dia buat direkrut.
heroes.desc_en: Durlan is a gentle giant with extraordinary strength. His heart is as soft as his power is rough. Meet him to recruit him.

gameplay.recruitment: Durlan | Abandoned Mine | The Headquarters must be at least Level 3 and the Mission: Mission Task 1 facility upgrade developed. Enter the mines via the Headquarters well and talk to Duran in the western dead end.; Reunion

heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — bergabung di akhir mini-arc Seign.

heroes.desc_id: Milhu adalah pemanah lincah dengan bidikan yang nggak pernah meleset. Gerakannya secepat kilat. Cari dia buat ngajak gabung.
heroes.desc_en: Milhu is an agile archer whose aim never misses. He moves as fast as lightning. Find him to invite him along.

She came to New Nevaeh for her family's rite of passage but got swept into Allraan's greater conflict. In Hundred Heroes, she joins after you solve the symbol puzzles in the Runebarrows.

heroes.desc_id: Euma Sia adalah raja Euchrisse yang bijaksana dan disegani. Keputusan-keputusannya menentukan nasib negerinya. Dia bergabung dengan Aliansi seiring cerita di Greatwood.

heroes.desc_en: Kassius is a cold strategist always one step ahead of his foes. His mind works like a war computer. Meet him to invite him along.

heroes.desc_en: Foxiel is a sly, nimble fox beastman. Sweet smile, but his mind never stops turning. Invite him when you meet.

heroes.recruit_id: Twinhorne West — di penginapan, ajak bicara.
heroes.recruit_en: Twinhorne West — at the inn, talk to him.
heroes.desc_id: Rohan adalah kesatria muda penuh idealisme yang percaya pada keadilan. Pedangnya selalu terhunus buat melindungi yang lemah. Cari dia buat ngajak gabung.
heroes.desc_en: Rohan is a young knight full of idealism who believes in justice. His sword is always drawn to protect the weak. Find him to invite him along.

gameplay.recruitment: Rohan | Twinhorne West | When the population of the Headquarters is over 5,000, speak to Rohan in the Twinhorne West In; Assault

heroes.name: Hogan
heroes.recruit_id: Twinhorne West — di dermaga; dia ingin kamu dapat minimal 50.000 baqua murni dari trading post (beli murah jual mahal: beli lukisan/ukiran di Ardinale City, jual lukisan di Hishahn, ukiran di Impershi'arc).
heroes.recruit_en: Twinhorne West — by the pier; he wants you to earn at least 50,000 baqua purely from trading posts (buy low sell high: buy paintings/carvings in Ardinale City, sell paintings in Hishahn, carvings in Impershi'arc).
heroes.desc_id: Hogan adalah pedagang ulung yang ngurus Trading Post di markas. Urusan jual-beli, dia jagonya. Rekrut dia lalu bangun Trading Post.
heroes.desc_en: Hogan is a master trader who runs the Trading Post at HQ. Buying and selling are his game. Recruit him, then build the Trading Post.

gameplay.recruitment: Hogan | Twinhorne West | Speak to Hogan at the end of the pier. The player now has to make make 50,000 profit in trading. Any earlier profit does not count towards this total. This challenge can be cheesed by buying up 50,000 worth of trade goods before speaking to Hogan, beginning the challenge from a base of 0, and then immediately selling everything to pass the threshold.; Assault

heroes.recruit_en: Hishahn/Seaside Cavern — south of the Hishahn shop bridge; complete his personal quest in the Seaside Caverns (unlock the barrier, defeat the Kraken boss using Gimmicks: lower water, use harpoon).
heroes.desc_id: Momo adalah gadis kecil periang yang selalu bawa keceriaan. Tawanya nular ke siapa pun di dekatnya. Temui dia buat direkrut.
heroes.desc_en: Momo is a bubbly little girl who always brings cheer. Her laughter is contagious to everyone near. Meet her to recruit her.

gameplay.recruitment: Momo | Hishahn | Cross the southeast bridge (south of the Smithy) to encounter Momo. Agree to Momo's request and defeat the Kraken boss in the Seaside Cavern .; Yarnaan Falls

walkthrough.summary_en: Nowa's first mission as a Watch member begins in Arenside Village. Here you learn the basics of combat and exploration while meeting your new comrades.
walkthrough.summary_id: Misi pertama Nowa sebagai anggota Watch dimulai di Desa Arenside. Di sini kamu belajar dasar bertarung dan menjelajah sambil berkenalan dengan rekan-rekan barumu.
walkthrough.title: First Mission — Arenside Village

walkthrough.summary_en: The Watch's first official mission takes you into the Northern Forest to locate the Runebarrows. Watch out for wild monsters and ancient traps inside the ruins.
walkthrough.summary_id: Misi resmi pertama Watch membawamu ke Hutan Utara untuk menemukan Runebarrows. Waspadalah terhadap monster liar dan jebakan kuno di dalam reruntuhan.
walkthrough.title: Into the Barrows — Northern Forest

walkthrough.summary_en: Explore the depths of the Northern Runebarrows alongside Seign. The mystery of the Primal Lens starts to unfold, but far greater dangers hide in the ruins.
walkthrough.summary_id: Jelajahi kedalaman Northern Runebarrows bersama Seign. Misteri Primal Lens mulai terkuak, tapi reruntuhannya menyimpan bahaya yang jauh lebih besar.
walkthrough.title: Search the Barrows — Northern Runebarrows

walkthrough.summary_en: Six months have passed and Nowa is now the Watch Captain. Your first assignment sends you around the town of Eltisweiss handling the locals' problems.
walkthrough.summary_id: Enam bulan berlalu dan Nowa kini menjabat Kapten Watch. Tugas pertamamu membawamu berkeliling kota Eltisweiss dan menangani masalah para warga.
walkthrough.title: The Watch Captain's First Job — Eltisweiss

walkthrough.summary_en: Bandits are troubling Altverden and their trail leads to the Abandoned Mine. Delve through its dark tunnels and deal with the criminals.
walkthrough.summary_id: Para bandit meresahkan Altverden dan jejaknya mengarah ke Tambang Terbengkalai. Susuri terowongan gelapnya dan bereskan para penjahat itu.
walkthrough.title: Searching the Tunnels — Abandoned Mine

walkthrough.summary_en: Nowa returns to Kyshiri Village, his hometown. The nostalgic visit does not last long before new trouble appears.
walkthrough.summary_id: Nowa pulang ke Desa Kyshiri, kampung halamannya. Kunjungan penuh nostalgia ini tidak bertahan lama sebelum masalah baru muncul.
walkthrough.title: Homecoming — Kyshiri

walkthrough.summary_en: A stealth mission into an Imperial camp begins at Werne Village. Move silently and gather intel without being spotted by the enemy.
walkthrough.summary_id: Misi penyusupan ke kamp Kekaisaran dimulai dari Desa Werne. Bergeraklah dalam diam dan kumpulkan informasi tanpa ketahuan musuh.
walkthrough.title: Infiltrate the Empire — Werne Village

walkthrough.summary_en: The Empire is preparing a major assault on Eltisweiss. Ready the town's defenses and face the incoming waves of enemy troops.
walkthrough.summary_id: Kekaisaran bersiap melancarkan serangan besar ke Eltisweiss. Siapkan pertahanan kota dan hadapi gelombang pasukan musuh yang datang.
walkthrough.title: The Eltisweiss Front — Eltisweiss

walkthrough.summary_en: After the battle, it is time to rebuild from Castle HQ. The Alliance officially forms and headquarters construction begins from its ruins.
walkthrough.summary_id: Usai pertempuran, saatnya membangun kembali dari Kastil HQ. Aliansi resmi terbentuk dan pembangunan markas dimulai dari reruntuhannya.
walkthrough.title: Hoist the Alliance Banner — Castle HQ

walkthrough.summary_en: The perspective shifts to Marisa, who wakes up in the mysterious Yarnaan. Explore the unfamiliar village and find out what is really going on.
walkthrough.summary_id: Sudut pandang beralih ke Marisa yang tersadar di Yarnaan yang misterius. Jelajahi desa asing ini dan cari tahu apa yang sebenarnya terjadi.
walkthrough.title: In an Unknown Village — Yarnaan

walkthrough.summary_en: Meet the Treefolk in the Greatwood and learn about their culture. Diplomacy here is vital for expanding the Alliance.
walkthrough.summary_id: Bertemu kaum Treefolk di Greatwood dan pelajari budaya mereka. Diplomasi di sini sangat penting untuk memperluas Aliansi.
walkthrough.title: The Village of the Treefolk — Greatwood

walkthrough.summary_en: Nowa and Marisa investigate a newly discovered Runebarrows while searching for Leene, Nowa's missing sister. Heavy trials already await inside.
walkthrough.summary_id: Nowa dan Marisa menyelidiki Runebarrows yang baru ditemukan sambil mencari Leene, kakak Nowa yang hilang. Ujian berat sudah menanti di dalam.
walkthrough.title: The Proving Grounds — Proving Grounds

walkthrough.summary_en: Travel to Euchrisse, the land of water, to reunite with Lady Perrielle. Alliance negotiations turn out to be trickier than expected.
walkthrough.summary_id: Perjalanan ke Euchrisse, negeri air, untuk bertemu kembali dengan Lady Perrielle. Negosiasi aliansi ternyata tidak semudah yang dibayangkan.
walkthrough.title: Euchrisse, the Land of Water — South Greatwood

walkthrough.summary_en: Investigate Harlan, King Euma's advisor, in the flooded Hishahn Old Town. Expose his schemes before it is all too late.
walkthrough.summary_id: Selidiki Harlan, penasihat Raja Euma, di Kota Tua Hishahn yang tergenang banjir. Bongkar rencananya sebelum semuanya terlambat.
walkthrough.title: Reveal Harlan's Schemes! — Hishahn Old Town

walkthrough.summary_en: The Empire invades Hishahn and the city must be defended. Lead the Alliance forces in a fierce battle.
walkthrough.summary_id: Kekaisaran menyerbu Hishahn dan kota ini harus dipertahankan. Pimpin pasukan Aliansi dalam pertempuran yang sengit.
walkthrough.title: The Hishahn Front — Hishahn

walkthrough.summary_en: Nowa and Barnard cross the desert toward Shandar Ridge to recruit new allies. The desert journey is full of danger.
walkthrough.summary_id: Nowa dan Barnard menyeberangi gurun menuju Shandar Ridge untuk merekrut sekutu baru. Perjalanan gurunnya penuh bahaya.
walkthrough.title: New Forces — Shandar Ridge

walkthrough.summary_en: Enter a contest at Impershi'arc to win the loyalty of the Shi'arcs. Win with clever strategy, not just brute strength.
walkthrough.summary_id: Ikuti kontes di Impershi'arc untuk memenangkan kesetiaan kaum Shi'arc. Menangkan dengan strategi cerdik, bukan sekadar kekuatan.
walkthrough.title: Shi'arcs of a Scale — Impershi'arc

walkthrough.summary_en: Seign's side investigates a Rune-Lens research laboratory. This mission shows the Imperial perspective along with the secrets behind the lens.
walkthrough.summary_id: Pihak Seign menyelidiki laboratorium penelitian Rune-Lens. Misi ini menampilkan sudut pandang Kekaisaran sekaligus rahasia di balik lens.
walkthrough.title: The Rune-Lens Research Laboratory

walkthrough.summary_en: Seek allies in the western nation of Norristar via Eldroad. Diplomacy between nations will decide the Alliance's future.
walkthrough.summary_id: Cari sekutu di bangsa barat Norristar melalui Eldroad. Diplomasi antar bangsa akan menentukan masa depan Aliansi.
walkthrough.title: To Norristar, the Western Nation — Eldroad

walkthrough.summary_en: Rescue the lost children, then follow their trail into the Ice Cave. The freezing cave hides dangerous monsters.
walkthrough.summary_id: Selamatkan anak-anak yang tersesat lalu ikuti jejak mereka masuk ke Gua Es. Dinginnya gua menyimpan monster-monster berbahaya.
walkthrough.title: In the Land of Snow — Ice Cave

walkthrough.summary_en: The Alliance hatches a secret plan to slow the Imperial advance at Snowpeak Pass. Precise execution is the key to success.

minigames.summary_en: Spinning-top battles in an arena: launch your top, use Boost to strike from the arena's edge, and win Clashes with button-mashing speed. Elements counter each other in a cycle: Fire beats Wind, Wind beats Earth, Earth beats Water, Water beats Fire.
